name: Coin battery backpack - No soldering needed

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a parametric button battery clip holder designed to securely hold a single coin cell battery. It features a circular main body representing the battery compartment, with a semi-circular front retaining wall (the divider) and a top cap section that encloses the battery. The design includes specialized wire routing holes and channels at the back and bottom to thread wires for making electrical contact with the battery terminals. A small mounting loop with a hole is positioned at the very top, and a rectangular mounting block with two screw holes is attached at the bottom for easy installation.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric, 3D-printable button battery holder in OpenSCAD. The script should support standard battery sizes like CR2032 and AG13, as well as a custom size option defined by radius and width parameters, and it must include wire holes for solderless connections and a mounting tab.
captions.factory: The code defines a 'holder' module that is assembled vertically by rotating a union of parts 90 degrees. It uses three main sub-modules: 'divider' which creates the front half-enclosure using a difference of cylinders, 'cap' which completes the upper enclosure, and a mounting block made of a subtracted cube. Wire routing channels and contact holes are created using subtracted cylinders and cubes. The script uses conditional logic to select the battery dimensions (radius and width) and supports creating a grid of multiple holders using nested loops.
